hypothesis.name: wPONS four-hop size-curve probe
hypothesis.rationale: Hypothesis needing fresh quotes: this WETH → USDG → PONS → wPONS → WETH route could show size-dependent net quote behavior across its supplied exact sizes. SIZE_CURVE must quote every supplied exact size up to 0.005 WETH and select the greatest current after-gas net; it must not scale outputs. Enter only when the selected quote meets the 20 bps edge floor and covers the 15000 bps gas-safety requirement for two consecutive eligible observations. The supplied training data does not validate this forward hypothesis.
